packets.object_description: Partial verifier-legal Lean proof-state graph plus a fallible goal-relative reachability representation.
packets.qoi: Paired fully-costed reduction in verified proof search versus the strongest fair parent, with theorem success non-inferior.
assumptions: kernel acceptance is the legality oracle
partial operational-map absence is not impossibility
geometry is routing only

strongest_parents.justification: Modern scalable best-first proof-tree search is a serious simple search parent.
AND/OR proof-tree search is a stronger structured parent for theorem proving.
White-box/factorized Lean search controls for gains caused by state decomposition.

packets.oracle_or_lower_bound: Kernel legality is exact; on materialized finite proof graphs exact shortest verified cost-to-go supplies an oracle geometry and lower-bound diagnostic, never a theorem-impossibility oracle.
minimal_counterexamples: locally aligned field greedily enters a dead end
quotient merges states with different proof obligations
short geometry path fails to decode to a kernel-valid proof
plain best-first wins despite worse local geometry
packets.falsifier: Strongest fair parent matches or beats VTG on fully-costed verified root outcome, or any kernel/quotient/portal/decode validity gate regresses.
packets.same_system_ablation: Same theorem/model/tactic/verifier/resource envelope with the geometry/routing coordinate disabled.
hard_gate_obligations: no abstract route mints theorem authority
packets.total_cost_equation: candidate_total = model_calls + tactic_generation + geometry_build + geometry_update + search + Lean_kernel_calls + decode + verification
packets.novelty_residual: Root-level verified search benefit attributable to reachability geometry beyond strong proof-search parents.
packets.permitted_publication_claim: Scoped routing/search-efficiency claim on the frozen Lean benchmark only; no theorem-truth or universal-geometry claim.

packets.object_description: Frozen portfolio of field constructors plus a proposal-only selector over task, reuse, update and locality regime.

exact field is an oracle ceiling not presumed winner

Pattern-database abstraction is a cheap structured constructor control.
Any field policy must beat the strongest direct search when construction does not amortize.

packets.oracle_or_lower_bound: Exact goal-set cost-to-go is the finite-world geometry oracle; useful-field economics require build+maintenance+extraction cost to be below verified search work saved over the registered horizon.

field beats BFS but loses to stronger cheap field

packets.same_system_ablation: Frozen strongest fixed constructor and no-field search under the same problem/query/update stream.
packets.total_cost_equation: candidate_total = build + maintenance(updates) + queries*(extraction + search + verification)
packets.novelty_residual: Adaptive cheapest-useful constructor selection or lazy construction benefit beyond the strongest fixed cheap field.
packets.permitted_publication_claim: Scoped field-selection/search-economics claim only; no claim that exact fields are globally superior.

different labels require same safe repair
one active intervention separates otherwise identical causes
greedy entropy probe loses decision utility

packets.total_cost_equation: candidate_total = diagnostic_compute + probes + interventions + repair + verification + registered_harm_cost
packets.novelty_residual: Decision-relevant identifiability and active discrimination benefit beyond passive/greedy information-gain diagnosis.
packets.permitted_publication_claim: Scoped solver-diagnosis/repair utility only; no scientific causal authority.
